label: FXOS8700 E-Compass
info: An e-compass: an inject node triggers the FXOS8700 every 200 ms. The chip runs in hybrid mode, so one 12-byte burst returns acceleration and magnetic field; the driver computes a tilt-compensated heading. A function node formats the heading as a compass point (N, NE, ...) and reports the board's pitch and roll derived from the acceleration vector, and a debug node shows the result. Rotate and tilt the board and watch the heading follow while the compass point updates. Adjust the I²C bus, address and magnetic declination in the device config node to match the wiring and your location.

name: compass point
